verdict.rationale: Vendor explicitly claims debugging/troubleshooting via natural language (gemini-cli-gh-3, gh-12/21 for on-demand debugging help, /bug command gh-20), but multiple hands-on community reports describe it getting stuck in error loops, failing basic function calls, being 'terrible at agentic stuff', and even causing a catastrophic data-loss incident during a task, directly contradicting reliable debugging performance.
